posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
Pretty much what it says on the tin.  There are tons of series listed now, split amongst all the various cards.  Which one goes in your weekly pull file?

 

For me, I think it's "Emigrant's Song".  I really like the interplay between Expatriette and the Citizens, and to have The Scholar making an appearance?  Yes, please!  It reminds me very much of "Huntress--Cry for Blood", which featured her with The Question, and those are two of my favorite DC characters.
